jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
What you'll find in this role

A sixty-person ed-tech company selling to schools and colleges is hiring its first dedicated project manager. Product, content, sales and customer success all run their own projects today, and school onboarding season is when the gaps show. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps companies hire experienced professionals, and it is running this search.
What you would own

School and college onboarding projects, from signed contract to first live class
The cross-team release calendar, so that product changes do not land in the middle of an exam week
Content production schedules, working with curriculum writers and designers
A single weekly view of every open project, its owner, its next date and its risk

Day to day

You will run short stand-ups with each team, keep project plans in a tool people actually open, and step in when a deadline is at risk. You will also run a retrospective after each admissions cycle and turn what you learn into a checklist the next cycle uses.
Who will do well

3 to 7 years managing projects with several teams, ideally in a software or services company
Comfort with Jira, Asana, Notion or similar, and willingness to choose one and stick to it
Clear and brief written updates, and a habit of asking one useful question before offering an opinion
Patience with school administrators and the calendar they work to

Working arrangement

Location:
Remote (India)
What happens next

A short call with a Flexiple recruiter, a project walkthrough with the head of operations, a conversation with a product lead and a closing chat with a founder. We will keep your single application on file for future roles that match.

jobs.title: Builder Services Project Manager 2
jobs.description:
Cornerstone Building Brands is a leading manufacturer of exterior building products for residential and low-rise non-residential buildings in North America. Headquartered in Cary, N.C., we serve residential and commercial customers across the new construction and Repair & Remodel (R&R) markets. Our market-leading portfolio of products spans vinyl windows, vinyl siding, stone veneer, metal roofing, metal wall systems and metal accessories. Cornerstone Building Brands’ broad, multi-channel distribution platform and expansive national footprint includes more than 18,800 team members at manufacturing, distribution and office locations throughout North America. Corporate stewardship and Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) responsibility are embedded in our culture. We are committed to contributing positively to the communities where we live, work and play. For more information, visit us at http://cornerstonebuildingbrands.com
.

Job Description

This position sits within our Fortify Building Solutions business, which serves the pre-engineered metal buildings, metal roof & wall systems and steel building components industry. The primary responsibility of the Builder Services Project Manager 2 position is to facilitate quality and accurate Quotations, Purchase Orders, and Work Orders to ensure customer expectations are exceeded as well as prompt, courteous and professional responses to customer requests.

Major Responsibilities:

Exhibit a proven mastery of low and medium complexity technical projects, to own complete execution.
Review jobs processed by other team members for accuracy, class 1-8 orders.
Provide accurate and efficient processing of orders, quotations and inquiries from builders which includes clarifying, communication, order / quotation write-up and expediting orders in accordance with established policies and procedures
Communicate drawing and shipping schedules with customers / builders after they are established
Confirm / verify pricing received accurately reflects scope of work defined on Purchase Orders.
Promptly and professionally respond to all Customer, Builder and District Sales Manager inquiries
Promptly analyze and discuss with Customers and Builders the cost and scheduling impact of potential Change Orders. Promptly notify other departments of Change Orders.
Price and process Change Orders promptly to ensure customer expectations are met while maintaining or improving margins
Effectively communicate with other departments to ensure customer expectations are exceeded
Continually improve understanding of Cornerstone Building Brands Products and Procedures as well as improving ability to read and interpret Architectural Plans and Specifications.
Be a creative, positive partner with personnel in other departments to provide the required level of service to meet and exceed customer expectations.

Qualifications

Mastered ability to own and execute low and medium level complexity technical projects
Proficient ability to own and execute high level complexity technical projects
Effective written and verbal communication as well as mathematical skills
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Advanced understanding of general construction fundamentals and engineering principles
Advanced ability to read and interpret architectural plans and specifications.
The ability to communicate and work effectively with people at all levels, both internally and externally.

Education/Additional Information:

Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required.
Minimum 8 years industry experience in sales, estimating, engineering, drafting, or project management.

Additional Information

The US average base salary for this role is $65,500- 85,200 + medical, dental, vision benefits starting day 1 + 401k and PTO. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. (Full-time is defined as regularly working 30+ hours per week.)

#Fortify

Why work for Cornerstone Building Brands?

Our teams are at the heart of our purpose to positively contribute to the communities where we live, work and play
. Full-time* team members receive** medical, dental and vision benefits starting day 1. Other benefits include PTO, paid holidays, FSA, life insurance, LTD, STD, 401k, EAP, discount programs, tuition reimbursement, training, and professional development.

*Full-time is defined as regularly working 30+ hours per week. **Union programs may vary depending on the collective bargaining agreement.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager will serve as a critical link between the Information Technology team and business stakeholders, ensuring projects are well-defined, aligned to strategic goals, and successfully delivered. This role will operate within a PMO framework, driving governance, prioritization, and standardized delivery practices while managing a portfolio of technology and AI-related projects.

This position is available as a fully remote opportunity.

In partnership with Business Analysts and cross-functional teams, the Project Manager will focus on execution, stakeholder alignment, and delivery outcomes, helping bring innovative solutions to life while improving efficiency, scalability, and overall business impact.

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end delivery of projects within a PMO-driven framework, ensuring alignment with organizational strategy, governance standards, and best practices.
Manage a portfolio of projects of varying size and complexity, with a strong focus on AI-enabled initiatives, automation, and digital innovation.
Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans including scope, schedule, budget, risks, and dependencies.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define business requirements and ensure successful delivery of solutions that drive measurable outcomes.
Drive PMO standards and governance, including project intake, prioritization, stage gates, and status reporting.
Provide clear and concise updates to leadership through executive dashboards, presentations, and portfolio-level reporting.
Facilitate regular stakeholder meetings, steering committees, and working sessions to ensure alignment and transparency.
Coordinate internal teams and external vendors to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
Assist in the evaluation of software solutions, including AI platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs and enterprise architecture.
Analyze and optimize business processes, proactively identifying opportunities for efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement.
Drive adoption of new technologies through structured change management practices, training, and stakeholder engagement.
Support in gathering, documenting, and validating business and functional requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process analysis.
Coordinate end-user communications, including announcements, updates, and feedback collection during and after implementation.
Monitor user adoption and feedback and recommend enhancements and solutions to improve usability and adoption.
Serve as the liaison between IT, business teams, and leadership to ensure alignment across all project phases.
Ensure comprehensive documentation of project artifacts, decisions, risks, and lessons learned.
Support the continuous improvement of PMO processes, tools, templates, and reporting standards.

Requirements

Strong experience working within a PMO environment, including governance, portfolio management, and standardized delivery frameworks.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects concurrently while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality outcomes.
Hands-on experience with Smartsheet, including building advanced solutions, dashboards, and workflow automations.
Foundational understanding of AI tools and technologies, with experience or strong interest in applying AI to business problems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
Experience eliciting and documenting requirements from stakeholders at all organizational levels.
Ability to influence, build relationships, and manage competing priorities across teams.
Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail and sense of urgency.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
Experience delivering executive-level presentations and leading discussions with senior stakeholders.
Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), web technologies, and enterprise systems.
Experience with change management methodologies and driving user adoption.
Ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced, high-demand environment.
Strong business acumen with a focus on delivering measurable value.
Demonstrated curiosity and continuous learning mindset, especially in emerging technologies and AI innovation.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in IT project management, business analysis, or related roles.
Experience managing or contributing to AI, automation, or digital transformation initiatives preferred.
Smartsheet Product and Solution Certification strongly preferred.
PMP certification or equivalent project management training strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field preferred.

The primary location for this job posting is in Palo Alto, but other locations may be listed. The actual base pay offered will depend upon a variety of factors, including but not limited to the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, level of education, professional certifications and licenses, and work location. The anticipated pay range for this position is as follows:
Palo Alto, New York, San Francisco: $131,750 – $178,250 per year.
Austin, Boulder, Century City, Delaware, Los Angeles, Salt Lake City, San Diego, Seattle, Washington, D.C., and all other locations: $119,000 – $161,000 per year.

The compensation for this position may include a discretionary year-end merit bonus based on performance. We offer a highly competitive salary and benefits package.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Department:
Data & Engineering

Location:
Canada

Compensation:
CA$100,000 - CA$125,000 / year

Description

Who We Are

Mission
: At Clever Digital Marketing, we are on a mission to empower large-scale home improvement companies by fueling their top-line revenue through innovative digital marketing strategies. By bridging the gap in the industry for a highly profitable digital lead vendor, we've created a unique space where growth isn't just supported — it's catalyzed.

Product
: Clever Digital Marketing delivers outcome-driven paid advertising and strategic advising solutions. We don't focus on clicks and impressions — we focus on net sales. Our customized, data-driven strategies are tailored to each client's unique needs, ensuring measurable impact and scalable profitability across Google, Meta, and Microsoft ad platforms.

Scale
: Recognized by the Globe and Mail as the #1 Fastest-Growing Company in the Marketing & Advertising category and #42 across all of Canada, we are the growth engine behind some of North America's most ambitious home improvement brands — companies on track to generate over $500 million in combined revenue in 2026. With a team of 100+ across North America, $74M in digital ad spend managed, and 400,000+ leads generated, we've built something rare: a system where scale isn't luck. It's engineering.

Impact
: As trusted subject matter experts in the home improvement space, we are redefining what it means to deliver value. Our commitment to authenticity, collaboration, and continuous improvement ensures we remain a powerhouse of growth and measurable results for every client we serve. We don't do lead generation — we do revenue generation.

The Honest Truth About This Role

Our Data & Technology group has outgrown informal coordination. The group spans the Data Integrations & Engineering teams (our GCP-native Data Platform 2.0 and Google/Meta/Bing ad platform integrations), IT Security, and Compliance — including our SOC 2 readiness program and IT Security Plan. These workstreams compete for the same small set of technical hands, and today there is no dedicated delivery owner. Priorities collide, dependencies surface late, and important-but-not-urgent security and compliance work slips behind feature delivery.

You'll fix that. You won't inherit clean systems — you'll build them. So let's be direct about who we're looking for: a superb communicator & hands-on builder who has run technical programs before
, not someone who needs a playbook handed to them.

One boundary to be clear about up front: you own the how, you facilitate the what.
Delivery process, tracking, cadences, and risk management are yours to design and drive. What gets prioritized — roadmap and resourcing calls — you frame clearly for the leaders who decide. If you need roadmap authority to feel effective, this isn't your role. If making complex decisions easier and business-critical delivery more predictable is what energizes you, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Own Portfolio Visibility and Delivery

Build and maintain a single source of truth for status, dependencies, risks, and resourcing across data platform, integrations, IT security, and compliance workstreams
Run portfolio-level planning: sequence work across projects, surface conflicts before they become fire drills, and keep leadership informed without meetings-as-status-reports
Flag slippage, resourcing conflicts, and scope creep early — with options attached, not just alarms

Drive Security and Compliance Programs

Own delivery of SOC 2 readiness: evidence collection, control implementation tasks, access reviews, vendor risk assessments, policy work, and audit milestones — coordinated with internal subject matter experts, our compliance partners, and auditors
Drive execution of the IT Security Plan: turn it into sequenced, owned, tracked work, and keep it moving alongside feature delivery competing for the same engineers
Operate with a least-privilege mindset: you'll touch access-adjacent process (access reviews, onboarding/offboarding checklists, vendor intake) and are expected to flag scope-of-access questions rather than route around them

Run Right-Sized Agile Process

Adapt process to team size — we’re a small, senior unit, not a 200-person scaled-agile org
Own delivery cadence for the technical team — planning, standups, retros, backlog hygiene — process that serves delivery, not ceremony for its own sake
Protect the team's focus: manage intake so mid-sprint asks get triaged, not silently absorbed
Architect how the technical portfolio runs in Asana: templates, custom fields, dependencies, and portfolio views that give leadership visibility without asking

Facilitate Prioritization and Intake

Turn ad hoc requests from leadership, client services, and vendors into scoped, sequenced backlog items with effort, dependencies, and tradeoffs made explicit
Prepare prioritization decisions for the VP and leadership: frame the options, quantify cost-of-delay, and drive to a decision — the call itself sits with the decision-makers
Translate stakeholder needs into actionable requirements and specs the engineering team can build against

Coordinate Cross-Functional and External Work

Align internal stakeholders (client services, leadership, operations) and external parties (vendors, contractors, client-side technical contacts) on scope, timelines, and dependencies
Drive vendor- and contractor-delivered workstreams to completion: clear deliverables, tracked commitments, escalation before deadlines break
Diagnose root causes behind missed deadlines — capacity, prioritization, unclear scope, or workflow design — and fix the system, not the symptom

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

What We Are Looking For

3+ years of program or project management for technical teams (data, software, platform, or IT/security work) with real delivery accountability — you've owned outcomes, not just tracked tickets
Exposure to security or compliance work (audits, access reviews, policy rollouts) — and you treat it as real delivery, not overhead
You've built delivery systems from scratch — walked into a team with no structure and created the workflows, tooling, and habits that made it run
Working fluency in agile practices — enough to run the process well and enough judgment to know when to bend it
Technical literacy sufficient to be credible with engineers: you understand what a data pipeline is, why a schema change carries risk, what "blocked on API access" means, and why an access request's scope matters — and you're honest about what you don't know
Strong Asana skills at the architecture level, not just the user level
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority — driving delivery across people and vendors who don't report to you
Exceptional written communication: status reporting, requirements, and decision framing are core deliverables of this role, not overhead

Who You Are

Extreme Ownership — you take responsibility for whether work ships, not just whether the board is updated
A builder, hands-on and high-output — you build the system, roll it out, and iterate; you don't architect from 30,000 feet and delegate the details
A facilitator, not a bottleneck — you make decisions easier for decision-makers and work easier for builders
Direct and candid — you deliver honest status even when it's unwelcome, and push back on vague asks
Kaizen-driven — messy starting points energize you, and you leave every process better than you found it

Nice to Haves

Experience driving a security or compliance program (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar), working with compliance automation platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata), or alongside an external audit/compliance partner
Exposure to cloud data platforms (GCP, BigQuery) or modern data engineering workflows
Agency or multi-client environment experience
Product management exposure: PRDs, discovery, acceptance criteria
Formal certifications (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, CISA, Security+) — useful signal, not required

What You Will Not Do

Own roadmap or prioritization authority — you design and run the delivery system; what gets prioritized within it is facilitated by you and decided by leadership
Manage people — this is an individual contributor role with broad influence
Deliver hands-on engineering work — you'll be close to the technical work, but you won't write production code or SQL
Run client-facing account or campaign management

What Success Looks Like

At 30 days: You've taken over delivery tracking for the Technology portfolio. You know the state of every active workstream, where SOC 2 readiness and the IT Security Plan actually stand, and what you'll fix first.
At 60 days: The technical team's delivery cadence is running. SOC 2 and IT Security Plan work is sequenced, owned, and tracked against target dates. Intake has a single front door.
At 90 days: Leadership can see portfolio status without asking. Security and compliance milestones are landing on schedule rather than slipping behind feature work. You present a view of what comes next — process, tooling, and risks.

Benefits

What We Offer

An incredible team and culture — high-performance, feedback-oriented, and data-driven, where everyone is empowered to succeed. Our culture thrives on collaboration, extreme ownership, and Kaizen. This is more than a workplace — it's a place where you'll grow, learn, and thrive alongside passionate teammates who are as invested in your success as you are
Real ownership of production systems within a platform being built from the ground up — with a clear runway to grow your scope as you prove it
Be part of the #1 fastest-growing marketing company in Canada, redefining performance marketing for the home improvement industry
A modern, GCP-native stack with AI embedded in daily workflows — Claude and Gemini are tools you'll use every day, not novelties
Exposure to AI/NLQ, MMM modeling, and ML optimization layers as the proprietary platform matures
Fully remote work environment with the flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada
3+ weeks of paid time off annually, with the freedom to use them as you see fit
Comprehensive group benefits including health, dental, and vision
Company-provided MacBook Pro and home office budget to help you create your ideal workspace
A work abroad policy to support you when you need a fresh perspective
Merch deliveries and opportunities to connect with teammates at meetups and company-wide events
A defined growth path toward Senior Data Engineer for those who demonstrate consistent ownership, quality, and impact

Other

Job-Type: Full-Time Permanent
Standard business hours: 9am – 5pm ET
Working Arrangements: Remote within Canada — Occasional in-office collaboration opportunities. Candidates must be legally eligible to work in Canada.
Base Salary: $100,000 – $125,000 CAD per year

At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.

Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.

Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.

Summary

This role is responsible for leading and overseeing complex, cross-functional programs consisting of multiple related projects that drive strategic business outcomes. This role ensures alignment between program objectives and organizational priorities, establishes governance frameworks, manages interdependencies, and delivers measurable results through structured planning, execution, and stakeholder engagement.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Lead the design and evolution of cross-functional enablement programs that translate commercial strategy into scalable, measurable field readines

Define program scope, success criteria, milestones, governance structures, and operating cadence.

Establish and oversee integrated program plans, ensuring alignment across project timelines, resources, and deliverables.

Manage program-level risks, issues, dependencies, and trade-offs; drive resolution and escalate appropriately.

Integrate multiple workstreams (onboarding, methodology, product readiness, manager enablement) into cohesive roadmaps.

Partner with senior stakeholders to align priorities, clarify decision rights, and ensure sustained executive sponsorship.

Drive change management planning and execution to support adoption and business readiness.

Ensure adherence to enterprise governance standards, controls, and documentation requirements.

Facilitate cross-functional forums to drive accountability, transparency, and timely decision-making.

Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and continuous improvement within program execution practices.

Perform other duties and responsibilities as required to support business needs.

Job Level Competencies

Mastery knowledge of industry best practices and disciplines. Considered a subject matter expert within the organization and contributes to the development of new concepts, techniques and standards.

Develops solutions to highly complex and uniquely challenging situations. Assignments require extensive evaluation of alternatives and variables. Expected to make improvements to policies and procedures.

Works independently toward long-range goals and objectives. Assignments are often self-initiated using independent judgment and discretion. May act as informal team lead and/or coach less experienced team.

Serves as consultant to management and/or internal/external spokesperson for the organization on major initiatives related to policies, plans and long-range objectives.

Actions may impact on the organization and its reputation. Effects of erroneous decisions may be long-lasting, influence the future course of the organization and/or require the expenditure of extensive additional resources.

Qualifications

Typical experience: 3+ years in related role or experience.

Actual experience may vary depending on role complexity, geography, and internal development opportunities or a comparable mix of training, education, and experience.

Progressive experience leading complex, cross-functional programs or large-scale initiatives.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects with interconnected deliverables and stakeholders.

Strong understanding of program and project management methodologies and governance frameworks.

Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment in a matrixed environment.

Experience with financial tracking, resource management, and performance measurement.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Education: University degree preferred.

Project Management Professional (PMP), PgMP, PRINCE2, or comparable certification.

Experience leading enterprise-wide transformation or strategic initiatives.

Familiarity with portfolio management practices.

Exposure to change management methodologies.

Role: Global Program Manager
Duration: 6+ Months (Potential to Extend)
Work Location: Hybrid / Chicago IL 60601

Executive Summary
We are seeking an experienced Global Program Manager to bring multiple deductions initiatives together into one integrated, outcome-led program. The program spans three connected priorities: reducing incoming deductions, resolving deductions faster, and reducing financial leakage through improved recovery. This senior program leadership role will align global and regional stakeholders around one roadmap, governance model, and benefits framework, connecting process improvement, technology, data, policy, and organizational change.

About the Role
The Program Manager will own integrated planning, governance, delivery oversight, and benefits tracking for the global Deductions Program. You will turn initiatives at different stages of maturity into a coordinated execution plan with clear accountability, sequencing, dependencies, and resource requirements. Working across GBS, Finance, Sales, Customer Supply Chain, IT, data teams, and external partners, you will challenge fragmented approaches and enable timely decisions without relying on direct reporting authority. This is not a standalone IT project manager or deductions operations role: initiative owners remain accountable for their workstream delivery, functional decisions, and operational results, while you lead integration and drive delivery of agreed program outcomes. Global standards and regional deployment plans must reflect local requirements; North America-specific targets in the current program baseline must remain distinct from global commitments.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain one integrated program charter, roadmap, milestone plan, and critical path across deduction prevention, faster resolution, and leakage reduction; reconcile overlapping initiatives and dependencies rather than manage them as disconnected projects.
• Establish executive steering and cross-functional working governance, clear decision rights, named initiative owners, and disciplined risk, issue, dependency, and decision management; close ownership gaps and escalate decisions with options and business impact.
• Align global and regional leaders on program scope, priorities, operating-model changes, and measurable outcomes; secure resource commitments and resolve competing business and technology priorities through agreed governance.
• Integrate root-cause prevention efforts across pricing and allowances, quantity discrepancies, fees and fines, product master data, and system reason-code integrity, connecting Lean Six Sigma analysis with business-owned corrective actions.
• Coordinate technology and process delivery across HighRadius, Compass, and GFIN, including under-tolerance automation, the deduction resolution interface, Project Shield, and AI-enabled document parsing; integrate requirements, testing, release readiness, cutover, and stabilization with accountable delivery leads.
• Maintain an integrated view of business cases, budgets, capacity, vendor commitments, and delivery forecasts; recommend sequencing and scope trade-offs based on value, readiness, risk, and available resources, with changes approved through governance.
• Connect recovery policy, write-off controls, deduction playbooks, supply-chain validation, and third-party recovery activities into a coherent leakage-reduction plan, preserving functional approval authority and avoiding duplicate effort or double-counted benefits.
• Anticipate and manage cross-workstream risks, including interface failures, data quality, unresolved ownership, technology delays, operational capacity, and adoption readiness; drive mitigations and recovery plans with accountable owners.
• Provide concise, decision-ready executive reporting covering outcomes, benefits, milestones, financial outlook, dependencies, risks, and required interventions; partner with data teams to replace fragmented manual reporting with a trusted program performance view.
• Lead integrated change and deployment planning with regional and functional owners, covering standardized ways of working, Sales onboarding, training, business readiness, and operational handover; scale proven solutions while accommodating justified local requirements.
• Agree baselines, metric definitions, regional targets, and benefit owners with Finance and operational leaders; track incoming deduction ratio, resolution cycle time, automation, productivity, recovery, and leakage. Validate benefits against the approved baseline.

Required Qualifications

• Substantial progressive experience in transformation and program management, typically 10+ years overall, including at least 5 years leading complex, multi-workstream programs across countries and functions; demonstrated accountability beyond project coordination or status reporting.
• Proven delivery of integrated business and technology transformation with measurable financial and operational benefits, including executive governance, dependency management, resource planning, budget oversight, and benefits realization.
• Strong working knowledge of Order-to-Cash / Invoice-to-Cash and customer deductions, including trade and non-trade claims, validation, dispute resolution, recovery, write-offs, and the links to pricing, Sales Finance, and Customer Supply Chain.
• Ability to turn fragmented initiatives into one executable program with clear ownership, critical path dependencies, realistic sequencing, regional deployment plans, and traceability from business outcomes to delivered capabilities.
• Credibility with senior global and regional leaders; strong influencing, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills, with the judgment to challenge assumptions, secure commitments, and escalate effectively in a matrix environment.
• Strong analytical and financial acumen: able to scrutinize business cases, distinguish cash recovery from productivity and prevention benefits, validate baselines, and build reliable performance reporting without double counting.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our Global Engineering Services & Analytics (GESA) organization on the Power and Hydrogen Solutions team. In this role, you will own the asset management and continuous improvement program for Amazon’s global fleet of power and hydrogen resiliency assets—including generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), fuel cells, electrolyzers, hydrogen storage and dispensing systems, and related electrical and balance-of-plant infrastructure—deployed across Amazon’s global portfolio of fulfillment centers, sort centers, and delivery stations.

You will lead the corrective action process end to end: driving root cause analysis on equipment issues and outages, tracking corrective actions to closure, and mining issue patterns to identify and deliver continuous improvements across the fleet. You will manage continuous improvement projects in partnership with vendors and stakeholders—with safety as a non-negotiable priority—and own the lifecycle management of deployed assets to ensure uninterrupted, safe operations at Amazon sites worldwide.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will work cross-functionally with electrical and hydrogen engineering, operations, safety, construction, and procurement teams to deliver resilient, continuously improving power and hydrogen solutions at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Corrective Action & Root Cause Analysis

Own and manage the supplier corrective action process for power and hydrogen asset issues end to end—from issue intake and triage through investigation, corrective action, and verified closure.

Lead structured root cause analysis (RCA) on equipment failures, outages, near-misses, and safety events across generators, fuel cells, and hydrogen storage infrastructure/dispensing systems.

Track corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to closure; maintain a single source of truth for issue status, owners, due dates, and progress, and escalate stalled or at-risk items.

Establish and report corrective action KPIs (e.g., time-to-closure, recurrence rate, overdue actions); drive cadences that hold owners accountable for timely, high-quality resolution.

Partner with safety and engineering to ensure corrective actions eliminate hazards and address systemic causes—not just symptoms—and are validated as effective before closure.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

Analyze issue patterns and trends across the fleet to identify systemic opportunities for continuous improvement in reliability, safety, cost, and availability.

Translate recurring issues and RCA findings into a prioritized continuous improvement roadmap; define problem statements, success metrics, and business cases for each initiative.

Lead continuous improvement projects in partnership with vendors and stakeholders—scoping, planning, and driving them from idea through implementation and measured results.

Standardize and improve maintenance strategies, design guidelines, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) based on fleet learnings; drive adoption across the portfolio.

Use equipment performance and maintenance data to predict failures, optimize maintenance intervals, and demonstrate the impact of improvements over time.

Asset Lifecycle Management

Own lifecycle management of deployed power and hydrogen assets, ensuring reliability, safety, compliance, and performance throughout each asset’s service life.

Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programs for generators, BESS, fuel cells, hydrogen storage infrastructure/dispensing, and associated controls across assigned sites.

Manage end-of-life planning and replacement strategies for aging assets, including capital justification and prioritization.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management (Safety)

Manage continuous improvement and corrective action projects with vendors and stakeholders—including generator and fuel cell OEMs, BESS and hydrogen suppliers, electrical contractors, and service partners—holding them accountable to scope, schedule, quality, and safety standards.

Partner closely with Safety to ensure every project and corrective action meets Amazon’s safety requirements; embed safety reviews, controls, and sign-offs into the improvement lifecycle.

Serve as the primary point of contact between engineering, operations, safety, and external partners for asset management and continuous improvement activities at assigned sites.

Facilitate stakeholder alignment across regional operations, site leadership, safety, and corporate engineering to ensure improvements are adopted and sustained in steady-state operations.

Manage service agreements, change orders, purchase orders, and invoicing associated with corrective action and continuous improvement work.

Technical Leadership & Strategy

Support the development of Amazon’s global power and hydrogen resiliency strategy, including asset health frameworks, reliability scoring models, and continuous improvement prioritization criteria.

Evaluate emerging technologies in energy storage, distributed generation, hydrogen fuel cells and electrolysis, microgrid architecture, and renewable integration to inform the team’s technical and improvement roadmap.

Represent the Power and Hydrogen Solutions team in cross-functional reviews, leadership briefings, and incident response coordination.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Power Engineering, or a related field
Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering or Business Administration or a related field
Experience with process improvement, Kaizan, and Six Sigma, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
Experience with hydrogen technologies—fuel cells, hydrogen storage and dispensing infrastructure, power solutions.
Experience managing OEM and contractor relationships, service agreements, and capital planning for infrastructure assets.

Aprés runs company-wide projects that cross Operations, Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, and IT — new systems, new processes, new product programs. Today one project manager tracks that whole portfolio, and department leaders sponsor projects on top of running their own teams. As the number of projects grows, delivery depends on who is available rather than on a repeatable process.

This role runs cross-functional projects from start to finish, including IT-led initiatives that require close coordination with onsite business users, technical teams, and across time zones. It owns the plan, the schedule, the decision record, and the reporting for the projects it is assigned. It holds other departments to their commitments without taking over their work.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

Run assigned company projects end to end: charter, scope, schedule, budget, risk, and closeout — including projects that require discovery, requirements, technical planning, testing, rollout, and post-launch support.
Write the project charter. Get the executive sponsor and the business owner to approve it before work starts.
Break each project into tasks with one named owner and one date. Track them in Asana; where a project includes a technical build, track that build in Jira using epics, stories, and tasks.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), and resource forecasts.
Raise a blocked item to the sponsor within two business days. Do not let it sit.

Cross-Department and Technical Coordination

Act as the single point of contact for each assigned project.
Run the project meeting: agenda before, decisions and actions after. Facilitate project ceremonies as needed — kickoffs, standups, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and UAT sessions.
Record every project decision with the date, the decision, and the person who made it.
Translate business requirements into clear, actionable technical plans; support scope definition, triage questions, and validate proposed solutions with technical teams.
Work with IT when a project needs a system build. IT tracks the build in Jira and the PMO tracks the project in Asana. Link the two. Do not duplicate them.
Coordinate effectively with offshore development teams across time zones (up to roughly a 12-hour difference); ensure clear handoffs, timely updates, and removal of blockers.
Coordinate system integrations and data flows across internal and third-party applications; support integration testing plans and cutover activities.

Intake and Prioritization

Manage the PMO intake board in Asana. Review each new request, ask the questions needed to make it clear, and prepare it for prioritization.
Bring a prioritization recommendation to the President with the reasoning: business value, effort, dependencies, and risk.

Status Reporting

Report to leadership by exception. Escalate what needs a decision. Do not summarize everything.

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.   

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.  

Cybersecurity Manager

The Cybersecurity Manager is responsible for leading the organization's enterprise cybersecurity strategy, governance, and operations in a serverless cloud-first Microsoft 365 technology environment. This role will drive the centralization and standardization of the cybersecurity program, establish a scalable security operating model, and mature security capabilities across the enterprise. The Security Engineering and Operations Manager will develop and execute a cybersecurity roadmap aligned with business objectives, M&A activity, NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls v8.1, and evolving risk landscapes to strengthen the organization's security posture and resilience.

The ideal candidate possesses deep Microsoft 365 enterprise expertise and understands how to maximize the value of both native Microsoft security capabilities and MSSPs to create a comprehensive, telemetry-driven cybersecurity program. This leader will optimize the collection, integration, and operationalization of security data across Microsoft 365 Defender, Entra ID Suite, Intune, Purview, and third-party security platforms, ensuring MSSPs are strategically leveraged to enhance visibility, accelerate threat detection and response, and provide actionable insights that strengthen the organization's overall security posture.

The position will establish clearly defined roles, responsibilities, escalation paths, and accountability across internal teams and MSSP partners to ensure effective security operations, service delivery, continuous improvement, and organizational cybersecurity maturity.

The ideal candidate is a strategic leader who can define and execute a compelling cybersecurity vision while building and mentoring a high-performing cybersecurity team. This role is responsible for creating and advancing a mature, risk-based security program aligned with the NIST CSF 2.0 and CIS Controls v8.1, while developing and maintaining a collaborative operating model with MSSPs.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Build and manage clear internal cybersecurity team roles, responsibilities, and operating processes aligned with strategic MSSP partnerships.
Leverage deep Microsoft 365 Defender and Azure expertise to maximize security telemetry, visibility, and threat response through the strategic integration of Microsoft with third-party security platforms.
Lead the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise threat detection and incident response playbooks and runbooks, ensuring effective detection, containment, mitigation, remediation, recovery, and post-incident lessons learned activities across the organization.
Lead enterprise cyber-attack preparedness and crisis readiness by aligning people, processes, technologies, and testing programs to minimize operational risk and business impact from cyber incidents.
Develop, maintain, and operationalize enterprise incident response and crisis management programs, including response plans, tabletop exercises, recovery testing, and stakeholder communications, to ensure rapid containment, effective decision-making, and minimal business disruption during cyber incidents.
Implement and optimize security awareness training programs, leveraging industry best practices and measurable performance metrics to reduce human risk and provide leadership with clear visibility into cybersecurity awareness, engagement, and risk mitigation effectiveness.
Drive the continuous improvement of outsourced cybersecurity services by maturing security monitoring, threat detection and response, vulnerability management, cloud security, threat intelligence, and security validation programs to reduce risk and strengthen security posture.
Own and optimize enterprise security monitoring and protection capabilities, including EDR, ITDR, MDR, SIEM, Vulnerability Management, and Cloud Posture.
Oversee continuous threat exposure management through network vulnerability scanning, external penetration testing, and dark web scans.
Cloud Apps: Maintain visibility and control over the organization's cloud application portfolio through continuous discovery, classification, risk evaluation, and security oversight.
Oversee enterprise identity and access management by driving adoption of Entra ID SSO, SCIM-based automated provisioning, and centralized identity governance across connected applications.
Oversee enterprise identity and access governance for both Entra-integrated and non-SSO applications, ensuring secure authentication, authorization, user lifecycle management, and periodic access reviews across all business systems.
Develop, maintain, and annually update security policies and procedures while conducting regular tabletop exercises to validate incident response readiness, including DR, IR, and BC.
Oversee the management and optimization of email firewalls, including DMARC policy.
Oversee the management and optimization of network firewalls IDS/IPS.
Provide monthly executive reporting.

Education & Experience

Relevant education in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
6+ years of progressive IT and cybersecurity experience.
Experience leading cybersecurity transformation initiatives aligned to frameworks such as NIST CSF 2.0 and CIS Controls.

Thank you for taking the time to review our Business Analyst of Lending Systems position. At Leaders Credit Union, our mission is to “Power your passion and make lives better.” We are very intentional about the hiring and interview process, which means we take our time. We want to make sure that you find the perfect career path! We truly appreciate your interest in Leaders Credit Union.

Who is Leaders Credit Union? 
We are a member-owned financial cooperative. This means that we exist to serve the needs of the consumers who own accounts at Leaders Credit Union. They are owners, and their financial well-being is at the heart of every decision we make. We are one of the largest credit unions in West Tennessee, and one of the most stable. Our purpose is simple: to provide a sound, convenient alternative to traditional banking.

What Are Our Core Values? As a Team Member Of Leaders Credit Union, You Would Be Asked To Adhere To a Specific Set Of Core Values. These Values Should Govern All Decisions That Are Made When Serving Our Members’ Needs. These Values Are

Member Focused
Team Oriented
Community Minded
Forward Thinker
Trusted Partner

Why Leaders?
Leaders Credit Union has been ranked one of the Best Credit Unions to Work for six years in a row. So, what makes Leaders such a great place to work?

Great benefits! We offer healthcare, vacation time, sick time, 401k options, and a profit-sharing plan (just to name a few!) Our Human Resources team is always looking to ensure that our benefit packages are competitive.
Work with a mission! Our mission statement isn’t just something written on a billboard, we truly look to “power your passion and make lives better.” That mission is lived out by member-facing personnel as well as our back-office employees.
Extensive training! We go to great lengths to make sure you know your job responsibilities and are comfortable through a very thorough training process. But our training goes beyond that. We offer monthly classes on everything from mortgage products to conflict resolution. We give you the tools you need to succeed.
Room for growth! At Leaders, you are only limited by your own ambition. Being part of a quickly growing financial institution leaves room for personal growth, and we do our best to promote from within whenever possible.

What does a day as a Business Analyst of Lending Systems look like?

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Analyze lending data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Prepare reports and dashboards on loan production, portfolio performance, delinquency, and credit quality.
Monitor key lending metrics and communicate findings to lending leadership.
Analyze loan application data to monitor and improve instant decisioning capabilities.
Analyze loan pricing, yields, product performance, and portfolio trends.
Support credit-risk analysis, including delinquency, charge-offs, credit scores, and loan concentrations.
Act as system administrator for the credit union's loan origination system.
Identify opportunities to improve lending processes, efficiency, and member experience.
Perform loan underwriting alongside a team of experienced underwriters.
Complete special projects and additional analysis as requested.

What is the schedule?
Our hours for this position are 8:00am to 5:00 pm Monday through Friday. Sometimes giving top-notch member service may require a little overtime, but we value work-life-balance and do our best to limit this. **This is not a remote position.

Does your skillset and experience line up?
For this role, we are looking for someone who:

Has 2 to 5 years of similar or related experience.
Has a bachelor’s degree in business, data analytics or related field.
Hands-on experience with a Loan Origination System strongly preferred. Prior system

administrator, configuration, or "power user" experience is a significant plus.

Comfort with data and reporting tools preferred.
A process-improvement mindset - someone who notices friction in a workflow and proactively brings a solution, not just the problem.
Proficiency in Microsoft Suite of Products (Excel, Outlook, Word, etc.)
Must maintain a professional, courteous, and friendly atmosphere for members and co-workers.
Must have very strong communication skills with the ability to explain decisions and reasoning behind those decisions.
Must maintain a working knowledge of the credit union’s loan standards and governmental regulations.

If you think this role is the perfect fit for you, please apply, and upload your resume online. Once you have applied you will receive an email from our system saying your application has been received. Keep an eye on your email over the next few weeks as this is our main form of communication. If the next step for you is an interview, we will reach out via email. If this position isn’t the right fit at this time, we will keep your resume on file in case anything else comes available that you might be a great fit for.

Thank you for choosing Leaders!

jobs.description:
Lead Data Analyst (Head of Data)
Location:
Ireland/UK (Remote)

About Entity
Entity is building the destination for high calibre games on the web. A curated catalogue of bestselling full-scale game titles running natively in the browser: click a link and you’re playing in seconds on the device you already own.
There are no downloads, no installs and no new hardware. This new low-friction way of playing games is powered by the latest developments in web technologies such as WebAssembly and WebGPU, allowing us to render high-quality game experiences on your device. This is not a game streaming service; this is the power of the New Web.
For developers, we’re the official, licensed channel for proper games on the web. We offer self-serve D2C tools to publish, operate and grow their games, with social play, identity and a unique end-to-end business analytics suite built in.

We’ve signed top-tier publishers representing many millions of unit sales on PC and console to date and are preparing for our launch in 2027.

We’re early, funded and moving fast. Joining Entity at this stage is a rare opportunity to help shape our company and our mission. We are an AI-native business; embracing the latest technologies and tools is essential to being successful with us.

About the Role
We're hiring a Senior Data Analyst to own Entity's data end to end: deciding what we measure, making sure we capture it, and turning it into clear answers for the team, our investors and our game partners.
You'll define how we understand the performance of our platform and of every game on it, including player performance KPIs, social and viral growth, and the return on our growth and influencer campaigns, and much more. You'll work closely with engineering to build the tracking we need and with our growth team to make sure every campaign can be measured properly. This role is the centre of our intelligence operation. We have a unique end-to-end level of data transparency and access that unlocks huge value for ourselves and are game developers who chose us.
This is a role with real ownership at an early stage. The metrics, models and reporting you build will shape how Entity makes decisions as we grow.

Key Responsibilities
Own Entity's data end to end: what we track, how it's defined, what insights it gives us and how we can leverage those insights.
Define the core metrics for the platform and the per-game performance, including acquisition, engagement, retention and monetisation.
Shape our developer analytics dashboard / business intelligence suite, a core part of our offering to developers: decide which metrics developers see for their games, give useful insights and decide how they're presented, working with product and engineering to create something truly valuable
Work closely with CEO and finance team to create commercial reports and investor ready documents, helping use data to communicate business successes and find opportunities
Work with product and engineering teams to specify the event tracking and pipelines we need for new features, and make sure the data is accurate.
Partner with the growth team so every campaign is measurable, including the influencer and creator campaigns that drive most of our acquisition.
Build dashboards that give internal teams self-serve access to the numbers they need.
Present data clearly to internal teams, investors, the board and external partners, adapting depth and format to each.

Requirements
5+ years' experience in data analysis, with significant experience in games, gaming platforms, igaming or consumer apps with large player or user bases.
Deep demonstrable familiarity with the latest AI tools and capabilities and how that affects data analysis and approaches
Deep understanding of game and platform metrics, including retention cohorts, engagement, monetisation, LTV and virality measures such as K-factor.
Experience measuring user acquisition, including attribution, funnel analysis and campaign performance.
Experience measuring influencer or creator-led campaigns.
Advanced SQL and strong experience with a scripting language such as Python or R.
Hands-on experience with data warehouses, product analytics and BI tools.
Experience working with engineers to define event tracking and data schemas.
The ability to explain complex data simply and credibly to non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and investors.
Comfort owning a data function independently in an early-stage company.
Based in the UK or Ireland, with the right to work there.

Nice to Have
Experience at a games platform, storefront or publisher, analysing performance across many titles.
Experience designing analytics for external customers or partners, such as a developer or creator dashboard.
Hands-on data engineering experience, such as building pipelines or data models, to help shape that work with our engineering team.
Experience setting up a data function from scratch.
Experience with experimentation and A/B testing.
Experience with social or community features, and measuring their effect on retention and growth.
Experience preparing data for investor or board reporting.
Familiarity with privacy and data protection requirements such as GDPR.

Working Conditions
Entity is remote-first, but this role is only open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland, with a suitable home-working setup. We value autonomy, clear ownership, and outcome-driven work. Some flexibility in working hours is expected to support collaboration across the team. Occasional travel may be required for team sessions, industry events, or visits with development partners.

They will set the vision, strategy, and roadmap, and work alongside with stakeholders in the organization to make it happen. They know and love working with business intelligence tools, can model multidimensional datasets, and can partner effectively with business leaders to answer key business questions. They are analytical and creative, and don’t quit. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and with high opportunity for impact for those willing to roll up their sleeves and dive deep to achieve results.

Key job responsibilities

Own the design, development, and maintenance of scalable solutions for ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to support analytical and business needs.
Work with team leadership to understand the customer needs and concerns as well as define solutions.
Translate basic business problem statements into analysis requirements. Work with internal customers to define best output based on expressed stakeholder needs.

Job Tittle
: Global Program Manager
Duration

Location:
Chicago, IL 60601

Pay Rate: $90 - 120/hr

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Global Program Manager to bring multiple deductions initiatives together into one integrated, outcome-led program. The program spans three connected priorities: reducing incoming deductions, resolving deductions faster, and reducing financial leakage through improved recovery. This senior program leadership role will align global and regional stakeholders around one roadmap, governance model, and benefits framework, connecting process improvement, technology, data, policy, and organizational change.

About the Role The Program Manager will own integrated planning, governance, delivery oversight, and benefits tracking for the global Deductions Program. You will turn initiatives at different stages of maturity into a coordinated execution plan with clear accountability, sequencing, dependencies, and resource requirements. Working across GBS, Finance, Sales, Customer Supply Chain, IT, data teams, and external partners, you will challenge fragmented approaches and enable timely decisions without relying on direct reporting authority. This is not a standalone IT project manager or deductions operations role: initiative owners remain accountable for their workstream delivery, functional decisions, and operational results, while you lead integration and drive delivery of agreed program outcomes. Global standards and regional deployment plans must reflect local requirements; North America-specific targets in the current program baseline must remain distinct from global commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain one integrated program charter, roadmap, milestone plan, and critical path across deduction prevention, faster resolution, and leakage reduction; reconcile overlapping initiatives and dependencies rather than manage them as disconnected projects.
Establish executive steering and cross-functional working governance, clear decision rights, named initiative owners, and disciplined risk, issue, dependency, and decision management; close ownership gaps and escalate decisions with options and business impact.
Align global and regional leaders on program scope, priorities, operating-model changes, and measurable outcomes; secure resource commitments and resolve competing business and technology priorities through agreed governance.
Integrate root-cause prevention efforts across pricing and allowances, quantity discrepancies, fees and fines, product master data, and system reason-code integrity, connecting Lean Six Sigma analysis with business-owned corrective actions.
Coordinate technology and process delivery across HighRadius, Compass, and GFIN, including under-tolerance automation, the deduction resolution interface, Project Shield, and AI-enabled document parsing; integrate requirements, testing, release readiness, cutover, and stabilization with accountable delivery leads.
Maintain an integrated view of business cases, budgets, capacity, vendor commitments, and delivery forecasts; recommend sequencing and scope trade-offs based on value, readiness, risk, and available resources, with changes approved through governance.
Connect recovery policy, write-off controls, deduction playbooks, supply-chain validation, and third-party recovery activities into a coherent leakage-reduction plan, preserving functional approval authority and avoiding duplicate effort or double-counted benefits.
Anticipate and manage cross-workstream risks, including interface failures, data quality, unresolved ownership, technology delays, operational capacity, and adoption readiness; drive mitigations and recovery plans with accountable owners.
Provide concise, decision-ready executive reporting covering outcomes, benefits, milestones, financial outlook, dependencies, risks, and required interventions; partner with data teams to replace fragmented manual reporting with a trusted program performance view.
Lead integrated change and deployment planning with regional and functional owners, covering standardized ways of working, Sales onboarding, training, business readiness, and operational handover; scale proven solutions while accommodating justified local requirements.
Agree baselines, metric definitions, regional targets, and benefit owners with Finance and operational leaders; track incoming deduction ratio, resolution cycle time, automation, productivity, recovery, and leakage. Validate benefits against the approved baseline.

Required Qualifications

Substantial progressive experience in transformation and program management, typically 10+ years overall, including at least 5 years leading complex, multi-workstream programs across countries and functions; demonstrated accountability beyond project coordination or status reporting.
Proven delivery of integrated business and technology transformation with measurable financial and operational benefits, including executive governance, dependency management, resource planning, budget oversight, and benefits realization.
Strong working knowledge of Order-to-Cash / Invoice-to-Cash and customer deductions, including trade and non-trade claims, validation, dispute resolution, recovery, write-offs, and the links to pricing, Sales Finance, and Customer Supply Chain.
Ability to turn fragmented initiatives into one executable program with clear ownership, critical path dependencies, realistic sequencing, regional deployment plans, and traceability from business outcomes to delivered capabilities.
Credibility with senior global and regional leaders; strong influencing, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills, with the judgment to challenge assumptions, secure commitments, and escalate effectively in a matrix environment.
Strong analytical and financial acumen: able to scrutinize business cases, distinguish cash recovery from productivity and prevention benefits, validate baselines, and build reliable performance reporting without double counting.
Excellent executive communication and facilitation skills, translating complex operational and technology issues into concise recommendations, clear decisions, and accountable actions across regions and time zones.
Practical understanding of enterprise system integrations, data quality, automation, testing, and change adoption; able to challenge business and technical delivery plans without needing to be a solution architect or hands-on developer.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with HighRadius or comparable deductions and receivables platforms, ERP interfaces, trade-spend processes, and customer-level deduction analytics.
Experience applying AI-enabled document processing, automation, and analytics to finance operations, with appropriate validation, controls, and operational adoption.
Program or project management certification such as PgMP, PMP, or MSP; Lean Six Sigma qualification and experience combining structured program governance with Agile delivery.
Experience coordinating technology vendors, implementation partners, and recovery providers within a single business-led delivery and value-realization framework.
Experience in global GBS or shared-services transformation and consumer goods or similarly complex customer environments, balancing global standards with regional operating requirements.

What Success Looks Like (First 1–3 Months)

One approved program roadmap connects all three outcome pillars, with named initiative and benefit owners, agreed regional scope, resource commitments, and active dependency and decision management.
Executive and working governance consistently resolve cross-functional trade-offs; ownership and reporting gaps are closed, and a trusted dashboard links delivery progress to validated financial and operational outcomes.
Prioritized process, platform, integration, and data improvements are delivered against agreed milestones, with business readiness, effective controls, stable operations, and clear handover to accountable teams.
Finance-validated results demonstrate progress against agreed regional baselines and targets for fewer incoming deductions, faster resolution, greater automation and productivity, and reduced leakage; proven improvements have a clear global scaling and adoption plan.

Programming and Administration

Build and manage a roster of marketing thought leaders, freelancers, and trainers to curate learning experiences for AMA’s community of marketing professionals at various stages in their career.
Collaborate across internal teams and external stakeholders to manage scheduling, logistics, and content preparation for AMA’s paid training programs.

Experience building relationships and influencing stakeholders.

Experience within a professional association
Experience in Marketing (this is our audience!)
Experience with Google Suite and Asana
Experience with Salesforce

Why the AMA

The AMA is the essential community for marketers, from students to executives to academics. Through our five scholarly journals, conferences, PCM® certification, 70 regional chapters, and presence on 350 college campuses, we help the profession learn, grow, and make a lasting impact. Remote, but not alone. Teammates in 20+ states, annual team member summit in Chicago, monthly town halls, and lots of cross-team collaboration.

4 weeks of parental bonding/caregiver leave
2 weeks of paid vacation
13 paid holidays
6 paid volunteer days
Flex Fridays

30-minute phone interview with a member of the People and Culture team.
Short assignment to present to the hiring manager in the virtual interview
Virtual interview with the hiring manager and the stakeholders you'll work with most.

We won’t leave you hanging. You will always hear from us within a week about the status of your application and status.

Job Description

Contexte du poste

Dans le cadre de la transformation de son système d'information dédié au trading d'énergie, notre client recherche un Senior Business Analyst pour accompagner ses équipes métiers et IT dans la modernisation de ses applications.

Un projet stratégique de migration vers une nouvelle plateforme ETRM est en cours afin de remplacer le système historique par une solution moderne et évolutive.

Vous interviendrez à l'interface entre les équipes métiers, les développeurs et les éditeurs afin de recueillir les besoins, formaliser les exigences fonctionnelles et accompagner leur implémentation.

Responsabilités

Analyse métier et conception fonctionnelle

Recueillir, analyser et formaliser les besoins métiers.
Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles, fonctionnalités et User Stories.
Comprendre les processus de trading et proposer des solutions adaptées aux besoins opérationnels.

jobs.description:
The Security Analyst is responsible for safeguarding the organization's IT infrastructure and data by owning daily operational security, privacy, and compliance workflows. This role focuses on executing day-to-day triage, coordinating evidence collection for multiple concurrent audits, and administering security awareness and privacy tasks to support the overall security posture of Windsor Fashions. The ideal candidate brings strong organizational and technical skills to manage first-line security events and maintain compliance timelines.

Essential Job Functions & Responsibilities:

Security Operations:
Perform first-line triage and investigation of Rapid7 and CrowdStrike alerts. Generate weekly vulnerability reporting, validate patches and updates, and monitor threat intelligence against Windsor’s environment.
Audit Support:
Coordinate internal evidence collection, manage compliance artifacts, and track remediation tasks across multiple concurrent assessments, including Grant Thornton (financial), AON (cybersecurity), Tevora (PCI-DSS Level 1), and the annual CCPA Cybersecurity Audit. Support the Manager as the internal engine driving the workflow behind external assessor engagements.
Privacy Operations:
Administer the OneTrust platform, manage Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) workflows, and drive cross-department follow-ups to ensure all statutory privacy timelines are met.
Third-Party Risk Management:
Perform first-pass vendor security reviews. Ingest and evaluate industry-standard vendor questionnaires—specifically the Standardized Information Gathering (SIG) questionnaire and the Consensus Assessments Initiative Questionnaire (CAIQ)—and track Data Processing Agreements (DPAs).
Awareness and Training:
Administer the security awareness training platform. Track user assignments for corporate and store employees, execute phishing simulations, and generate compliance reporting to meet audit requirements.
Policy Administration:
Manage the intake process for policy exceptions and risk-acceptance workflows. Schedule regular policy review cycles and ensure control-evidence documentation is kept up to date.
Tabletop and IR Support:
Provide logistical and administrative support for incident response readiness. Assist with scenario preparation, scheduling, and tracking after-action items to closure.

Key Qualifications & Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in a security analyst or security operations role.
Strong understanding of core security principles and operational best practices.
Hands-on experience with vulnerability management platforms and endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools.
Knowledge of network and system administration within cloud and retail environments.
Excellent problem-solving, project coordination, and analytical skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multi-department audit stakeholders.
Certifications such as CompTIA's Security+ and CySA+, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or AWS Certified Security - Specialty are a plus.

Adequate movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Team members are required to have close visual acuity to perform activities such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.

new_jobs.description:
